text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] control-plane 5xx spike detected (alert cp-5xx-1941003456) — elevated 5xx and timeouts from API gateway to downstream control-plane deps. paging oncall.

ellaine.c: seeing a big jump in 502/504 from gateway -> auth and org-lookup. 5xx% ~18% over 5m, error budget burning. multiple customer reports of LLM inference failing with 5xx.

raj.p: i'm on it. quick triage: auth-prod-eu pods show high request latency and ~30% 5xx. org-lookup service (org-svc) has spikes of timeouts and errors like `org lookup timeout` in the logs.

marta.s: can someone check billing and config? last config push was ~02:50 UTC — if config service is falling it can cascade. also check kvstore connections (Redis/TLS) — seeing some connection refused patterns earlier.

sam.k: grabbing logs from auth-prod-eu and org-svc now. sample tail:
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:03Z] auth: error=rpc error: code=Unavailable desc="connection reset by peer" tenant=acme
[2026-03-15T02:12:03Z] org-svc: warn="lookup timeout" duration_ms=12000 trace_id=...
[2026-03-15T02:12:05Z] billing: error="nil pointer" stack=...
```

jen.l: mitigation proposals: 1) enable auth-legacy fallback routing for affected tenants, 2) increase gateway retry backoff to 2 retries with 250ms jitter, 3) temporarily blacklist org-svc variant v2 and route to v1 if healthy, 4) scale up auth-prod-eu by +2 replicas. Can we do a quick canary revert of the config push?

elaine.c: agree. priority is to restore customer success. doing fallback routing + scale now. raj, can you confirm circuit breaker/trip thresholds so we don't thrash downstream?

raj.p: checking CBs. org-svc has no circuit-breaker on the gateway path for lookups — that's bad. I'll add a temporary rate limiter at the gateway (200 rps hard cap per org) to stop cascading.

pagerduty: @oncall acknowledged the page — handoff to secondline after 15 min.

sam.k: executed scaleup: `kubectl scale deployment auth-prod-eu --replicas=6 -n control-plane` (took ~25s). also rolled routing change to use auth-legacy for tenant tags: `region:eu,cust-tier:premium` — routing updated.

marta.s: observed immediate drop in auth 5xx after routing change and scale. org-svc still has intermittent timeouts, but traffic drop reduced error rate from 18% -> 6% in 4m. customers still see occasional timeouts.

jen.l: pushed gateway temp config: retries=2, backoff=250ms, jitter=true. added a per-tenant throttle at 200 rps.

raj.p: while we have breathing room, we should verify billing and config services. sam, can you dump recent config pushes? `kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=config-svc -n control-plane` and check for failed pod restarts.

sam.k: yes — config-svc had a failed init at 02:48 UTC. Logs show config apply attempted and a schema validation NPE. Reverted the config push at 02:55 UTC (`config-service revert v2026-03-15-0250`). After revert config-svc restarted healthy.

elaine.c: so root cause hypothesis: bad config push caused config-svc instability -> billing validated config and crashed -> increased load/latency to auth/org lookup (retries) -> gateway 5xx. cascade.

jen.l: mitigation summary applied: revert config, scale auth, enable auth fallback, gateway retry/backoff, temporary per-tenant throttle. Monitoring shows 5xx back down to ~1.5% over last 10m.

marta.s: customer impact: about 12 tenants saw degraded requests for ~20-40m (depends on region). Ticketing: open a SEV with affected tenant list and duration.

raj.p: we should also add a short-term circuit-breaker on org-lookup path and a guard in config-svc to fail-safe on bad schema (reject apply without crashing).

sam.k: runbook actions executed and logged in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1941003456 (internal link). Adding commands used:
```bash
# health checks
curl -sS https://auth-prod-eu.internal/healthz | jq .
curl -sS https://org-svc.internal/healthz | jq .
# scale
kubectl scale deploy auth-prod-eu -n control-plane --replicas=6
# revert config
configctl rollback --service=config-svc --to-tag=v2026-03-14-2300
```

pagerduty: handoff note — secondline takes on-call for followup at 03:00 UTC. primary remains to own comms with customers.

elaine.c: status update to #incidents: mitigated, customer impact limited, continuing monitoring. preparing postmortem. action items:
- add CB on org-lookup path (raj)
- add config-svc validation + non-crashing apply (marta)
- improve runbook for multi-dep cascade (sam)
- customer comms draft (jen)

jen.l: drafting customer comms now. will include affected tenants, times, mitigation steps, and planned fixes.

sam.k: logging timeline in incident doc + attaching logs and config diff.

raj.p: will follow up on implementing CB and rate-limit rules. aiming for patch by EOD.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. page closed. postmortem required.

elaine.c: thanks everyone. please ack action items in the incident doc. closing thread once postmortem PR submitted. :thumbsup:
